instruction: A hornbill perched on a short stump, chiseled from a single block of warm mahogany with visible gouge facets across the breast and wings. The huge curved bill and casque are polished glassy smooth in contrasting pale maple, and shallow relief lines suggest each folded flight feather. Dark grain sweeps diagonally through the tail, and a light wax finish gives it a soft honeyed glow.
